  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JANUARY 7, 2020

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 5:45 p.m., on
  Tuesday, January 7, 2020, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street and teleconferenced at The Orleans
  Hotel, 4500 W. Tropicana Avenue, Room 1954 and 1956, Las Vegas, Nevada 89103.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day (arrived via teleconference at 5:47 p.m.)
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Greg Morena
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:45 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem O’Day. Councilmember Morena
  led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:48 p.m., to consider
  arrived via teleconference at  closed sessions and returned at 8:20 p.m., with Councilmembers Morena,
  5:47 p.m.  Himmelrich and Mayor Pro Tem O’Day absent, to report the following:

  1.A. Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation --

  Code Section 54956.9(d)(2): 4 cases.

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.
